correctness.rationale: The 16 edge vertices and degree <=2 definition are exact. Independently enumerated all 2^16 edge masks and checked face cardinalities (1,16,120,508,1213,1476,714,60). Reconstructed two complete greedy discrete-Morse matchings (2018 and 2026 pairs), topologically sorted each directed Hasse digraph on 4107 nonempty faces and all 18700 incidences, evaluated all signed Morse projection boundaries: increasing-order matrices C4->C3 9x42 rank 8, C5->C4 42x21 rank 15; opposite-order 2x34 rank 1 and 34x20 rank 14. Independent exact integral unit-pivot eliminations found only units and zero remainders, and boundary compositions were zero. Hence groups 1,19,6 and integral torsion-freeness. Finite exhaustive certificate proves this graph only; no wedge or general graph statement.
